escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, The Glass Ball Under the Bomber, by General Mole, with over 429 thousand likes.
In second place, ПЕТЯ ИНГЛИШ: НАЧАЛО, by Petya English, with over 442 thousand likes.
And number one: World's Biggest Human Catapult 🤯, by Red Bull, with over 644 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
